scope: ONE trained block under DD, the per-row division dictionary (D30; TinyLlama-1.1B or Llama-3-8B at T128, or the synthetic DD rung): the integer model the calibration export names; NOT a model pass; NOT a soundness or privacy acceptance (D30 requires an independent soundness review and the gate first); float fidelity is the calibration lane's measurement

constants_source: this layer's manifest (the export marks ["exp_e_s", "norm_cn_a", "norm_cn_m", "sh_ao", "sh_h", "sh_s", "sh_z", "silu_member"] per-layer); one calibration for this one-block run
